blocks.title: Lead Human
blocks.premise: Stephen’s signature keynote: how relational intelligence fuels *performance, retention and trust*.
overview: In high-pressure, often hybrid workplaces, most performance breakdowns start in relationships. Burnout, disengagement, retention loss and cultural drift are symptoms of a deeper issue: leaders are trained to manage tasks, and the human system around those tasks goes unmanaged.
This keynote introduces a practical, research-informed framework for clearing silent friction, strengthening trust, and leading through influence.
outcomes: Diagnose the hidden relational dynamics that affect retention and engagement.
Apply a clear framework for high-trust leadership.
Reduce tension and misalignment before performance declines.
Lead with presence and emotional credibility under pressure.
blocks.audience: Executive teams and senior leaders, managers and emerging leaders, and human-centered organizations.

blocks.title: Invisible Friction
blocks.premise: Why teams break down, and how to clear the *hidden barriers* to performance.
overview: A lot of what wears a team down never gets said out loud. This talk looks at the quiet breakdowns that affect culture and collaboration, and shows leaders how to bring difficult conversations into the open and turn avoidance into alignment.
outcomes: Identify silent breakdowns affecting culture and collaboration.
blocks.audience: Teams navigating change, growth or cultural strain, and the managers who lead them.

blocks.title: The Hidden Multiplier
blocks.premise: How relational intelligence drives *retention, safety and results*.
overview: Trust shows up in the numbers an organization already tracks. This talk connects everyday relational patterns to performance outcomes, and gives leaders daily habits that keep engagement up and protect culture through growth and change.
outcomes: Connect relational patterns to measurable performance outcomes.
Build the kind of trust that helps people stay.
Increase engagement through daily relational rituals.
Protect culture during growth and change.
blocks.audience: Executive teams, people and culture leaders, and associations and professional membership organizations.
